bypass.reason: api_call_with_retry() depth 5 — standard retry-with-backoff pattern, nesting is inherent to retry loops

Public API exports for cross-branch consumption (get_drive_service, authenticate_google, validate_google, reauth_google). Tested in test_google_client.py. Backup migration pending.
make_call() is a CLI orchestrator — parses args then delegates to client.get_response(). All business logic lives in handlers/openrouter/client.py.

fetch_contracts() and call_contract() are test API hooks called from tests/test_integrations.py. The unused_function checker excludes test dirs from its search corpus, so these appear unused despite being actively called. Encapsulation standard requires tests to go through modules, not import handlers directly — these functions serve that purpose.

fetch_api_key() and fetch_validate_key() are module-level wrappers called from tests/test_critical_paths.py. The unused_function checker excludes test dirs from its search corpus. Encapsulation standard requires tests to go through modules — these functions serve that purpose (DPLAN-0155).

Utility module — owns no drone commands (handle_command always returns False). The no-args gate assumes the module owns the command it is handed; here it fired for EVERY no-arg command in the branch, prepending this module's banner to other modules' output. Removed 2026-08-13 (APLAN-0013), proven live. Introspection stays reachable via __main__.
